# exo_mailbox_permission (Resource)

Manages one user's explicit permissions on a mailbox, e.g. FullAccess on a shared mailbox. Create runs Add-MailboxPermission, destroy runs Remove-MailboxPermission, and read uses Get-MailboxPermission -User, ignoring inherited, deny and NT AUTHORITY\SELF entries. Import with `<identity>/<user>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exo_mailbox_permission" "support_alice" {
  identity      = "support@contoso.com"
  user          = "alice@contoso.com"
  access_rights = ["FullAccess"]
  automapping   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_rights` (Set of String) Maps to -AccessRights. Allowed values: ChangeOwner, ChangePermission, DeleteItem, ExternalAccount, FullAccess, ReadPermission. Added and removed rights are updated in place.
- `identity` (String) The mailbox (-Identity). Changing it forces replacement.
- `user` (String) The user or group granted the permissions (-User). Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `automapping` (Boolean) Maps to -AutoMapping, which only Add-MailboxPermission takes and Get-MailboxPermission does not return. Changing it forces replacement, except after import, where it is only recorded.
- `inheritance_type` (String) Maps to -InheritanceType. Allowed values: None, All, Children, Descendents, SelfAndChildren. Defaults to All. Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<identity>/<user>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is <identity>/<user>.
terraform import exo_mailbox_permission.support_alice support@contoso.com/alice@contoso.com
```
